newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE's Emaar Properties in initial public offering.
newsitem.headline: UAE's Emaar Properties in initial public offering.

text.p: Newly-constituted United Arab Emirates real estate firm Emaar Properties said on Wednesday it would offer 29.7 million shares at 10 dirhams each in an initial public offering to UAE nationals.
Subscription would run from April 2 to April 14. The minimum subscription is 500 shares and the maximum is 2.7 million.

"On behalf of the 79 founder shareholders of Emaar Properties, who have already committed 243 million dirhams, I am pleased to announce the forthcoming public share issue of 29.7 million shares," founding committee member Mohamed Alabbar said.

Alabbar, also head of Dubai emirate's Economic Department, said the offering would widen investment opportunities in the UAE, where liquidity is good, but the business scene is generally dominated by big family concerns.
Alabbar told Reuters Emaar would be involved in a wide range of real estate from commercial buildings, housing compounds and golf courses to tourist facilities and infrastructure projects.
He said Emaar was being formed ahead of the long-planned establishment of an official UAE stock exchange.
